description: South Sudan - Damage density map in Morobo-Kaya road, Nahr Yei district is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected damage density along the road connecting the cities of Morobo and Koya, Nahr Yei district, Central Equatoria, South Sudan. Using satellite imagery acquired 05 March 2017, UNITAR - UNOSAT identified a total of around 7,800 destroyed structures within the analysis extent of the current map (approximately 600 square kilometers). Coverage: South Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
